tagline: 理光便携相机，1986 年发布
description: 理光于1986年推出的便携相机。快门速度Programmed electronic shutter, 1/6–1/1500 s.。使用Easy loading, pre-loading.。感光度DX decoding from 50 to 1600 ISO. Non-DX films set as ISO 100.。Autofocus with pre-focus ability, closest range 1 m.。

specs.对焦: Autofocus with pre-focus ability, closest range 1 m.
specs.取景器: Albada type with bright lines, parallax correction marks and zone indication. Adjusted according to lens focal length. 0,61–0,39 x magnification, 83 % field of view.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in pop-up flash, manually activated. Can be used as fill flash. GN 14. Reloads in 3 seconds. Underexposure warning lamp.
specs.感光度: DX decoding from 50 to 1600 ISO. Non-DX films set as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh TF-200 is an 80s compact camera with autofocus and a 38 mm lens, switchable to 65 mm by a ring around the lens.
